content:
Medical professional liability insurance in Moldova must be assessed against a particular specialty and service. This page confirms no offer suitable for every doctor or clinic. It is an information resource for an institution needing risk and availability assessment, not a universal product offer.

Editorial revision: 26 November 2026. The 2027 scenarios are planning examples, not forecasts or confirmation of individual insurance terms.

Who needs an accurate description?

A clinic manager, independent practitioner or contract coordinator should distinguish the institution, employed professional and visiting service provider. An organisation's policy must not automatically be described as protection for every professional working anywhere. INTACT’s general professional-liability category, checked 26 November 2026, does not confirm acceptance of medical specialties, clinic services or availability of a medical product for 2027.

Describe actual services, locations, professionals and working relationships. Consultations and invasive procedures require different questions, but this guide does not assess their clinical safety. Medical quality and legal liability need appropriate specialist consideration rather than an insurance conclusion based on the service name.

Separate the claim and the expenses

Discuss patient allegations, possible legal-defence costs and other expenditure separately. A complaint does not by itself establish an error. Equally, buying insurance does not determine liability or promise an automatic payment to a patient. The relevant facts and documents must be examined.

Where a genuine proposal exists, request the accepted activities, insured people, limits and claims mechanism. Ask how treatment dates, receipt of a complaint and notification interact. Do not import a foreign claims-made arrangement, meaning a connection with when a claim is made, unless it is actually specified in the proposal.

Price factors and exclusions

Price discussion follows confirmation that the specialty and activity can be considered. Assessment may request the service mix, institutional information, activity scale, requested limit and relevant claim history. This article has no verified 2027 tariff for doctors or clinics. A price for a different profession is not a medical quotation.

The National Bank of Moldova’s contract guide explains contract components and questions for reading conditions. Checked 26 November 2026; it does not confirm a particular product, tariff or 2027 terms.

Ask how the document treats known complaints, services outside the accepted specialty, promises of an outcome and work by collaborators. These are questions about possible restrictions, not a universal exclusion list. Payment of a premium must not be presented as moving an already known problem into a new contract.

A practical 2027 planning scenario

Three situations for a practical decision

These examples are entirely hypothetical and do not describe real customers. They show what to check and which records to prepare; no risk acceptance or payment is implied.

  • Situation: An institution first asks whether insurance can be considered. What to check: Describe specialties and actual services. Obtain an activity-assessment response instead of transferring a general professional category to medicine. Document: An institutional, service and professional-role summary without patient histories.
  • Situation: A visiting professional works at several sites. What to check: Separate contractual roles and service locations. One institution’s document does not confirm the person’s entire practice. Document: Collaboration agreements and distinct descriptions of locations and services.
  • Situation: A patient complaint has already arrived. What to check: Preserve the original message and unaltered records, identify applicable contracts and appropriate professional assistance. Do not promise payment through new insurance. Document: The complaint chronology and relevant existing contract; sensitive material uses an agreed confidential route.

For later reviews, keep a register of new services, locations, professionals and complaint-receipt arrangements. An answer for the previous site does not automatically apply to a new one. Retain document versions and written explanations, not only the latest marketing brochure. Administrative records organise information but do not replace clinical governance.

Documents and confidential handling

An initial discussion can use the organisational structure, services, locations and aggregate complaint information. Do not put patient histories, diagnoses or personal records into a public form. Agree the necessary detailed documents, authorised recipient and confidential transmission route before supplying sensitive information.

When a complaint arrives, retain its original wording and timeline without retrospective changes. Medical, legal and insurance assessments are distinct. Insurance ING Broker SRL acts as broker: it can help organise insurance information but does not establish a medical error, replace a lawyer in litigation or promise an insurer's decision.

Practical prevention

Prevent administrative misunderstandings by making no unverified insurance-payment promise to patients, retaining accurate versions of declared services and defining the complaint-receipt route. Clinical risk prevention remains the responsibility of competent medical professionals, not an insurance-marketing article.

Frequently asked questions

How should a clinic check whether insurance can be considered?

Describe specialties, services, locations, the organisation and professional roles. Request confirmation that the actual activity can be assessed. A public professional-liability category does not replace that answer or establish a product suitable for all medical professionals.

What information may be needed for a cost discussion?

After availability is clarified, prepare the service mix, activity scale, requested limits and any requested aggregate claim history. A price for another profession or clinic is not your tariff. Patient information requires an agreed confidential transmission route.

What records should be kept after a patient complaint?

Retain the original complaint, receipt date and an unaltered document chronology. Identify the applicable policy and appropriate legal and medical assistance. A complaint does not establish an error or entitlement to payment; this guide does not replace clinical assessment.

How should dates and defence costs be checked?

Ask how service, claim and notification dates matter, and how specialists and expenses are agreed. Verify the mechanism against the particular contract rather than a foreign claims-made example. Do not treat every expense selected by the institution as already accepted by the insurer.

What needs review if a new room opens in 2027?

Describe the new services, location and visiting-professional arrangements, request assessment of the change and keep the response before making protection statements. This is a conditional planning example, not a demand forecast or a statement of future compulsory insurance.
